incidents.name: AIDC pair-side accumulated burn
incidents.notes: AIDCToken lets an ordinary router transfer burn the accumulated sell-side amount directly out of the AIDC/WBNB pair and then sync it, so repeated fresh-helper sells deflated the pair's AIDC reserve and let the attacker buy the pool out.

sources.ref: onchain review: AIDC 0x5021d71859F81B4c905b573591db8F9Cc4A0C6fe created 2026-06-27 by 0x0ca5c15d3a173065dbecfcfda0963ce8acf70668, unrelated to attack sender 0x89eb2c99e970d831525c7a52badc290afa116b63; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; ~220.13 WBNB drained from pair 0x2725033282b3bd4BE8873B7F0f622c18E3b7cbd8 one day after deployment
